**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The MINCOMMIT rule is satisfied at the **preferred** position. This agreement is a development-financing arrangement in which the money flows to us:

- **No purchase/volume commitment on PB.** SFJ is the party bound to fund (up to $120m of Development Costs, § 4.1/§ 4.2). Our payments to SFJ under ARTICLE 6 are contingent Approval Payments payable only "following Regulatory Approval" — no take-or-pay, no shortfall, no volume cap on us.
- **The $110m Elected Total Amount floor (§ 4.2.3(ii)) is not a take-or-pay.** It is a floor on funding we must *accept*, not on what we must *buy*, and it only bites after a Successful Phase 3 Interim Analysis.
- **The cost-overrun/spend covenants (§ 4.1, § 4.2.3)** — excess Development Costs "borne by PB" and the covenant to spend at least the amount SFJ funds — are use-of-proceeds and overrun allocations on our own programme, not obligations to purchase from the counterparty.
- **Exit exists in any event.** § 14.2.2 gives us at-will termination once SFJ has paid or incurred $60m and before first Regulatory Approval, and § 6.7 gives us a Buy-Out election. The 300% figure in § 14.2.2 is a priced financing return, better assessed under the termination/exit-cost rules than double-flagged here.
